headline: Executive order sets up how federal agencies plan to keep their key work going during emergencies or disruptions.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with "mission resilience," meaning the ability of the federal government to keep doing its most important jobs during a crisis. It sets up how that planning is overseen and coordinated across federal agencies. No official summary was provided, so the specific rules and assignments are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They are likely directed to plan and coordinate so their essential functions can continue during emergencies.

who_it_affects.group: Federal employees who work on emergency and continuity planning
who_it_affects.how: Their planning work is likely shaped by the oversight and coordination structure the order sets up.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 7, 2020; executive orders usually take effect when signed, but no specific date was provided.
